thread:
maria: Quick follow-up from POSTMORTEM-2012. We need an actionable list for tests/evals: regression additions, incident-tagged prompt sets, a focused load run, and a small-scope chaos drill. Who can own what?

kevin: I can take the regression-suite expansion. plan is to add 8 new prompt groups capturing the KV-eviction patterns and two flaky-cases we saw. ETA: first draft 2026-04-12.

maria: thanks. please add 1-2 line acceptance criteria in Jira.

kevin: will do. acceptance: new prompts added + automated pass/fail matrix + baseline perf numbers.

ryan: I'll own the load profile. prefer to exercise dedicated burst pool for the main run; do smoke on hosted first. aiming for a 5k steady + 12k burst spike scenario. tentative run 2026-04-18.

tina: I'll curate prompt sets and the negative controls. tagging each prompt with incident=kv-eviction-2026-03. target draft 2026-04-09.

maria: tina, please also add a small human-reviewed sample for each promptset so we can sanity-check eval pass criteria.

tina: noted.

infra-bot: Created JIRA TST-5012, TST-5013, TST-5014 and linked to POSTMORTEM-2012.

ci-bot: CI checklist reminder: attach test definitions and expected outcomes to the tickets before running automated evaluation.

ryan: question on blast radius for chaos drill: I propose single-region, single-tunnel KV eviction with immediate model-fallback test. I can coordinate with SRE. dry-run 2026-04-21.

maria: agree. keep blast radius small and include automated rollback steps.

kevin: side note: we should create an eval threshold to alert on regressions >2.5% for critical prompts. add to TST-5012.

maria: yep add metrics + monitoring dashboard link.

ryan: I'll open a quota request for the dedicated pool now. infra-bot please advise on lead time.

infra-bot: Reminder: quota increase requests require 48h lead time for dedicated runs.

maria: great. final asks: each owner add acceptance criteria and link sample prompts by EOD Friday. we'll have a 20m sync on 2026-04-06 15:00 UTC to confirm. invite to follow.

kevin: noted, will add.

tina: will add samples.

ryan: will file quota request and load plan.

maria: thanks all. I'll consolidate into the postmortem ticket and track the JIRA items weekly until closed.
